Orthophenylphenol 2-Biphenylol; E231; E232 (sodium-o-phenylphenol); 2-Hydroxy- biphenyl; o-Hydroxydiphenyl; Ortofenilfenol. (1,1′-Biphenyl)-2- ol. C12H10O = 170.2. CAS — 90-43-7. ATC — D08AE06. ATC Vet — QD08AE06. Profile Orthophenylphenol is a phenolic disinfectant with antimicrobial properties similar to those of chloroxylenol (p.1640). It is used for disinfection of skin, hands, instruments, and hard surfaces. It also has many industrial and agricultural uses as a preservative for a wide range of materials, particularly against moulds and rots. Sodium-o-phenylphenol has been used similarly.
